key_insight: UniBrain unifies brain MRI modality imputation and multimodal understanding in one model, aiming to handle missing scans while supporting diagnosis and reasoning.
clinical_relevance: This could improve robustness of AI-assisted brain MRI analysis in real-world settings where not all imaging modalities are available.
method: Interleaved, description-enriched training for autoregressive multimodal learning
Self-alignment with dense image embeddings to capture fine-grained anatomy without detailed captions
Dynamic hidden state mechanism to reduce exposure bias in long-context inference
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive experiments on a multi-disease brain MRI dataset, showing strong performance for imputation, understanding, and disease diagnosis across different levels of missing modalities.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality and diversity of training data, and real-world deployment still needs careful validation across scanners, sites, and missing-modality patterns.
paper_title: Unified Multimodal Model for Brain MRI Imputation and Understanding
